entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Identity: DataProtectorTokenProvider ignores TimeProvider, though the ASP.NET Core 11 release notes list token expiration #70678
  • [review-pull-request] CCR overview cards deduplicate distinct anchored worker candidates without verification (#70532) #70674
  • [Flakiness] Windows local development validation succeeds on retry after build exit #70673
  • SignalR JS client stays in Reconnecting forever when a handshake error is received while HttpConnection is still Connecting (stop() never resolves) #70670
  • Quarantine Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.FunctionalTests.RealServerUsingMinimalBackedIntegrationTests.RetrievesDataFromRealServer #70662
  • Untagged submodules #70657
  • Failed to parse '...\obj\Debug\net11.0\staticwebassets.development.json': Missing Asset #70656
  • [API Proposal] Add paused-circuit cleanup callback to Blazor reconnection handlers #70655
  • SignalR TS client: the timeout and the abort signal of FetchHttpClient stop at the response headers #70654
  • SignalR TS client: IStreamSubscriber.closed is documented, but the client never sets it #70653
  • SignalR TS client: the check for multiple client results ignores a falsy result #70652
  • SignalR TS client: after stop() and start(), the Ack timer of the old connection sends on the new connection #70651
  • SignalR TS client: tough-cookie is loaded at run time but is not declared as a dependency #70650
  • SignalR TS client: a client method named "constructor" breaks on() and the client results #70649
  • SignalR TS client: with a binary hub protocol, the handshake response is decoded as Latin-1, not as UTF-8 #70648
  • SignalR TS client: send() and invoke() reject with a string, not with an Error #70647
  • SignalR TS client: the client continues to send an upload stream after the server completes the invocation #70646
  • SignalR TS client: a failed Server-Sent Events connect does not close its EventSource #70645
  • SignalR TS client: with stateful reconnect, a message in the frame of the handshake response is not counted #70644
  • SignalR TS client: after a failed stateful reconnect, the automatic reconnect connects, but no message goes in or out #70643
  • SignalR TS client: an onclose, onreconnecting or onreconnected callback that throws stops the callbacks after it #70642
  • SignalR TS client: the second of two adjacent stream arguments is sent as a plain argument #70641
  • Static SSR: ErrorBoundary catching an exception fails the request when the page has a named form #70640

Closed

  • Kestrel accepts HTTP/1.1 request lines with no space before the version and silently rewrites the target (regression in #51535) #69857
    12.0-preview1
  • Why is there reluctance to unify file encoding formats? I upgraded to dotnet 11, but it's still disappointing #70671
